limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

search.description: Find metrics for a measure instead of reading the whole catalog. Send the user's words, the likely metric name, and the spelled-out form of an acronym, separated by commas, such as 'mrr, monthly recurring revenue'. Results come best match first, 10 by default, and match_reason says why each one matched. Words match by stem in the name, display name, description, and definition. Synonyms do not match unless the metric's text contains them.
